metadata.target: first observed creatinine-defined KDIGO-2012 AKI within next 24h
metadata.calibration: Monotone sigmoid fitted on patient-disjoint source calibration subset
metadata.threshold_selection: source calibration: maximize precision at sensitivity >=0.80
metadata.explanation_method: Replace one feature group with development-set medians; report probability difference. Non-additive and non-causal; not SHAP.
limitations: Documented urine volumes have unknown collection coverage and are not urine rates
Observed creatinine baseline may miss pre-existing AKI
Outcome visibility depends on laboratory testing
24h horizon does not guarantee 24h lead time
No established transportability beyond evaluated samples
